address: 26/7 Ban Len, Bang Pa-in, Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya, 13160, Thailand
bio: Known for the grilled river prawns it has served since 1991, this family-friendly restaurant on the Chao Phraya River has two dining areas: on a raft and boat, respectively. Either way, diners enjoy gentle breezes and scenic views with their meals. The culinary offerings, which have grown since the restaurant first opened, are skilfully cooked using fresh local ingredients. The speciality, grilled river prawns served with a flavourful spicy sauce, is a must-try....
